one_line_description: Platform for deploying and managing modern web applications
auth_methods_evidence: Netlify uses OAuth2 for authentication. All requests must use HTTPS. To generate a personal access token (PAT):...Use your PAT for manual authentication in shell scripts or commands that use the Netlify API. To authenticate API requests, include the token in the authorization header: `Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN>`
self_serve_evidence: To generate a personal access token (PAT): 1. Go to [ Applications > Personal access tokens](https://app.netlify.com/user/applications#personal-access-tokens). 2. Select New access token.
buildability_rationale: Good documentation, OAuth2 and bearer token authentication, broad API surface, and self-serve access with free tier available.
agent_notes: The documentation provides clear authentication methods and API usage instructions. The API has a broad surface area with multiple endpoints for various functionalities.
